answer_1.quote: In this work, we explore the application of knowledge distillation in the context of the creative style-transfer task of conditional humor generation. Given a literal text, the goal is to generate a humorous meaning-preserving paraphrase...
answer_1.outputs: humorous meaning-preserving paraphrase of a literal input

answer_2.quote: We use the LLM-based metric of Win Tie Rate (WTR) also described in Sec 3.2 for automatic evaluation. Traditional generation metrics such as ROUGE may not work well for the creative task of generating humor.

answer_3.quote: The critic, an LLM (Large Language Model), evaluates the humor quality of outputs from the finetuned student. We adopt a pairwise relative scoring approach ... Multiple Choice Prompting (MCP) presents the two paraphrases to the model and instructs it to choose the better one. We compute the automatic WTR of the student models using both the critic model based on Llama2-70B and GPT-4.

answer_4.quote: In order to validate the role of the teacher as a critic model, we conduct blind human evaluation by some of the authors ("annotators"). Annotators are asked to rank the paraphrases based on how humorous they are and how consistent they are with respect to the meaning of the input.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank the paraphrases based on how humorous they are and how consistent they are with the original input meaning.
